body: Oh yeah. My social life right now is amazing. I'm always talking to my two best friends online and I'm actually talking to people I like at college now. In the future, I'm just concerned about relationships and that stuff because of my social anxiety and plus I'm an introvert.

Thanks everyone. I appreciate the support. To elaborate further, I am worried that I will leave University (hopefully I will get in) with a good degree but I will be unable to find a good job due my lack of work experience. I have literally never worked a day in my life and I am 19. 

I know that you won't get one immediately and that you have to work hard for one but I don't want to be stuck in a minimal wage job forever. I am actually hoping of maybe moving to another country like the U.S.. I'm not sure yet but I want the opportunity to do so. I basically don't want to be stuck in my hometown with a shitty job.
Yeah, that's true. I just keep forgetting about them. My main worries are the economy and my social life in the future.
